manuscript_prose.section1_title: Evolutionary Transition from Asgardarchaeota to the Compartmentalized Eukaryotic Nucleus
manuscript_prose.section1_p1: The origin of the membrane-bound nucleus represents the defining cellular divide between prokaryotic archaea and the Last Eukaryotic Common Ancestor (LECA). Closed and open nuclear envelopes decouple RNA polymerase II transcription and spliceosomal intron removal inside a protected nucleoplasm from cytosolic translation on 80S ribosomes, preventing aberrant translation of unspliced pre-mRNA introns while organizing chromosomes onto octameric histone arrays.
manuscript_prose.section1_p2: Across 64 taxa spanning Euryarchaeota outgroups [A], TACK Proteoarchaeota [B], complete Asgardarchaeota genomes [C] (Promethearchaeum, Lokiarchaeum, Flexarchaeum, Margulisarchaeum, Odinarchaeum, and Heimdallarchaeum), and crown eukaryotic supergroups [D]-[G], partitioned ModelTest and Dual-Pass Blinded validation trace three integrated functional pillars: (1) Asgard ESCRT-III and VPS4 ATPase endomembrane scaffolding, (2) Nuclear Pore Complex coatomer architecture powered by the Ran-GTPase (1BYU) nucleocytoplasmic gradient, and (3) histone H3 chromatin compaction paired with RNAP II RPB2 transcriptional compartmentalization.
manuscript_prose.section2_title: Per-Locus BIC ModelTest, Third-Codon RY3 Compositional De-Biasing & Proterozoic Chronogram
manuscript_prose.section3_title: 64-Species Quartet Multispecies Coalescent, Eocyte-Heimdallarchaeia Root & ABBA-BABA Tests
manuscript_prose.section4_title: ESCRT-III VPS4 Scaffolding, Histone H3 Chromatin, RNAP II RPB2 & Ran-GTPase (1BYU) Dynamics
manuscript_prose.section4_body: Across four nuclear-origin functional gene families under Standard Genetic Code 1, 61-state Goldman-Yang codon models quantify purifying selection maintaining the AAA+ ATPase pore of ESCRT-III disassembly factor VPS4 (FAM-01), core nucleosomal Histone H3 (FAM-02), and the active cleft of RNA polymerase II RPB2 (FAM-03). Alongside these three compartments, nuclear transport master GTPase RAN/GSP1 (FAM-04) is threaded onto the 2.15 A crystal structure of GDP-bound Ran (PDB 1BYU Chain A), preserving the Walker A P-loop (GDGGTGKT), Switch II hydrolysis loop (DTAGQE), and octahedral Mg2+ A 221 coordination via Thr24 Og1 that establishes directional nucleocytoplasmic import and export across LECA nuclear pores.
manuscript_prose.section5_title: Single-Species Archaeal & Eukaryotic Skylines (Code 1/11 vs. SSU 18S rRNA) & Stage 3C Clusters
discussion_paragraphs: Integrating universal transcriptional (RPB1, RPB2), translational (EF1A, EF2, SSU/LSU rRNA), ATPase (VMA1, VMA2), chaperonin (CCT/thermosome), and homologous recombination (RAD51/radA) orthologs under per-locus BIC ModelTest with third-codon RY3 recoding reduces cross-domain GC and thermophilic compositional heterogeneity between extremophilic archaea and eukaryotic supergroups. Within this unified topology, Asgardarchaeota lineages—particularly Heimdallarchaeia—branch in close association with the stem leading to LECA.

Comparative structural and selection analyses across VPS4, Histone H3, RNAP II RPB2, and Ran GTPase are consistent with a stepwise model of nuclear compartmentalization rather than an abrupt single innovation. Pre-existing archaeal endomembrane-remodeling VPS4/ESCRT-III ATPases, basic DNA-packaging proteins, and multisubunit RNAP complexes provided the molecular chassis upon which eukaryotic chromatin remodeling, spliceosomal intron shielding, and Ran-GDP/GTP gated nuclear pore transport (1BYU) became entrenched prior to the radiation of Discoba, Amoebozoa, Opisthokonta, Archaeplastida, and SAR.

Because this purely dry-lab phylogenomic and structural synthesis relies on public NCBI RefSeq/GenBank and RCSB PDB records audited through Dual-Pass Blinded checks and Quartet MSC reconciliation, Paleoproterozoic-to-Mesoproterozoic node age bounds remain conditional on deep substitution saturation across Archean archaeal branches and taxon availability among uncultivated Asgardarchaeota lineages.
manuscript_prose.latex_intro: Origin of the eukaryotic nucleus traced across Euryarchaeota, TACK Archaea, Asgardarchaeota, and four major eukaryotic supergroups via universal informational markers, VPS4/H3/RPB2/RAN codon selection, and 1BYU Ran-GDP structural threading.
